final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM g), s AS (SELECT g.c AS c, g.c*1.0/t.tot AS sh FROM g, t), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s), k AS (SELECT s.c AS c, s.sh AS sh, a.av AS av FROM s, a WHERE s.sh > a.av) SELECT AVG(c) AS avg_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - av) AS avg_excess FROM k
